_meta.palette_source: map.css (--bg #0f1b24, --acc #e0a63e, sky #8cc8f0, muted #9fb2bf) plus Okabe-Ito hues
_meta.schema_note: /workspace/audit/r25/battles_events_schema.md did not exist when this was written; field names follow the Historian's battle id scheme ('<place>-<year>') and war_id.

colourblind: Precision is shown by shape (solid disc, ring, halo, dashed ring), never by colour alone. Battles (vermillion #f08c6c) and events (sky #8cc8f0) stay apart under deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia thanks to the glyph difference (swords vs pin) and the luminance contrast against #0f1b24. In the war palette, wars that sit close in hue under CVD are told apart by a different hull stroke dash.

region.note: also draw the region polygon if present: fill #f08c6c @0.10, stroke #f08c6c 1 dash 4 3

reported.combine: reported + region gives this icon plus the halo at 0.5 opacity

event_pin.coexistence: Battle markers are centred on the point and pins are tip-anchored. When a battle and an event share a place_id or sit within 12 px, offset the pin +10 px east (west in RTL), draw a 1 px #9fb3c2 leader line, and keep the battle on top. Three or more markers within 24 px collapse into a count badge (#14232f fill, #e0a63e text) that expands on click.

timeline_ticks.range_events: bar from start to end at 0.4 opacity, ticks at the ends
timeline_ticks.hover: tick to #ffd54a and show a tooltip
timeline_ticks.selected: tick to #ffd54a, w+1, synced with the map marker

z_order_bottom_to_top: reported clashes (same layer as battles, drawn under confirmed ones)

war_footprint.trigger: select a war chip, or select a battle and choose 'show war'
war_footprint.palette_note: 20 slots covering every war_id in db/wars.json plus the Analyst's post-1956 ids. Each slot differs from the others in hue, dash pattern or both.

treatment.battles_in_war: opacity 1, outline 2 px war colour; other battles dim to 0.25, cities stay
treatment.hull: convex hull of the war's battle points (buffer 15 km; a single point gets a 25 km circle; region-precision points use their polygon), fill war colour @0.08, stroke war colour 1.5 px with hull_dash; RTL needs no change
treatment.sequence: optional thin 1 px war-colour polyline joining battles in date order, with small arrowheads, off by default
treatment.label: war name at the hull centroid, EN/AR [VERIFY], halo #0f1b24
treatment.legend_entry: swatch of hull + war name + date span + battle count
treatment.multi_war: up to 3 wars at once, each with its own hull dash; beyond that, show only the last selected

text.en: {short_name} {year}, with an alt name in brackets where one is common, e.g. 'Karari (Omdurman) 1898', 'Shaykan 1883', 'Kerma 1500 BCE'
text.bce: ids use a double hyphen (kerma--1500); labels show '1500 BCE' / '١٥٠٠ ق.م' [VERIFY]

label.font: map.css UI font, 12px at z<=6, 13px at z7-9, 14px at z>=10; weight 600 for decisive, 400 otherwise
label.placement: preferred to the right of the marker (left in RTL), then above, below, the opposite side; 4 px offset from the icon edge; never over the marker of another battle
priority: decisive: read from the decisive flag in data/battles.json (no hard-coded list)
label.collision: greedy by priority with 3 px padding; a lower-priority label that collides is hidden (marker stays, label on hover). City labels outrank non-decisive battle labels but not decisive ones. At z<=5 only decisive labels show.
label.rtl: in AR mode, mirror placement and keep the year as Arabic-Indic numerals [VERIFY]; parentheses mirror automatically with dir=rtl

contested.applies_to: items with badge 'CONTESTED' (e.g. south-sudan-civil-war 2013 battles in db/battles_post1956.json)
contested.consistent_with: map.css .hm.cont .dot uses an amber #e0a63e 1.5px outline for contested points; the same amber is used here

marker.outer_ring: #e0a63e 1.5px, drawn 1.5px outside the base icon's edge

corner_badge.position: top-right (top-left in RTL), offset so it overlaps the icon edge by 25%

combine.approximate: ring is drawn outside the vermillion ring with a 1px gap
combine.region: badge on the glyph centre's top-right; the halo is unchanged; the area outline goes amber dashed 4 3
combine.reported: badge + ring; the ring keeps the dashes (3 2.2) in amber so both states read

states.selected: yellow #ffd54a selection outline drawn outside the amber ring

contested.timeline_tick: amber 3px diamond cap on the tick

legend.en: Contested: sources disagree on control or outcome
legend.ar: متنازع عليه: تختلف المصادر حول السيطرة أو النتيجة [VERIFY]

contested.colourblind: amber is backed by the diamond shape and the ring, so it is never colour alone
